HEX~MANIAC~KATHLEEN sent out
Espeon and Starmie!

The opposing Espeon flinched
and couldn’t move!

The opposing Espeon lost
some of its HP!

Incineroar knocked off the opposing
Espeon’s Life~Or

The opposing Beheeyem couldn’t fully
protect itself

The opposing Reuniclus twisted
the dimensions!

Scizor’s Scizorite is reacting
to BRENDAN’s Mega Rin

Scizor has Mega Evolved
into Mega Scizor!

The opposing Medicham kept
going and crashed!

The opposing Medicham
lost some of its HP!
Flutter~Mane lost some of its HP!

Kingambit gained strength
from the fallen!

The opposing Latias’s Latiasite is
reacting to KATHL

The opposing Latias has Mega
Evolved into Mega Latia
Flutter~Mane lost some of its HP!

The twisted dimensions
returned to normal!
Flutter~Mane lost some of its HP!
